name: Technical Paradigms
description: Technical paradigms for implicit reasoning categorized based on where and how the internal computation unfolds.

items.name: latent_optimization
items.description: Directly adjusts and optimizes internal representations without emitting intermediate text.
phrases: adjusting target units in latent space
items.hard_negative: Prompting the model to output a hidden <think> block in the text response (this is an explicit output, even if it is hidden from the user's UI).

items.name: token_level
items.description: Steers reasoning by manipulating individual tokens.
items.hard_negative: Generating a full explicit Chain-of-Thought sequence of text tokens.

items.name: trajectory_level
items.description: Treats the reasoning trajectory as a unit of optimization, replacing explicit reasoning steps with continuous latent thoughts.
items.hard_negative: Modifying the weights of a single attention layer to process all inputs faster.

items.name: semantic_anchoring
items.description: Anchors latent trajectories to explicit reasoning supervision to ensure semantic fidelity.
phrases: compressing full traces into contemplation tokens
items.hard_negative: Randomly perturbing the latent space without any semantic alignment target.

items.name: adaptive_efficiency
items.description: Dynamically compresses intermediate thoughts during generation to adjust reasoning length or speed.
items.hard_negative: Statically pruning 50% of the model parameters before inference.

items.name: progressive_refinement
items.description: Refines the implicit reasoning process progressively by step-by-step internalization or iterative updating.
items.hard_negative: Standard one-pass supervised fine-tuning on final answers only.

items.name: exploratory_diversification
items.description: Introduces soft or perturbed latent representations to promote the diversity of possible reasoning trajectories.
items.hard_negative: Using standard nucleus sampling (top-p) to generate multiple diverse text responses.

items.name: internal_state_level
items.description: Takes the model's internal states as the target of reasoning regulation.
items.hard_negative: Inserting special control tokens into the prompt context.

items.name: signal_guided_control
items.description: Leverages specially designed control signals to steer the model's internal computation process.
items.hard_negative: Rewriting the user's prompt using an external system before passing it to the LLM.

items.name: single_type_signal
items.description: A single control mechanism that uniformly modulates the reasoning dynamics (e.g., fixed tokens or adaptive token placement).
items.hard_negative: Using distinct tokens to explicitly trigger memory retrieval vs. logic calculation separately.

items.name: multi_type_signal
items.description: Employs multiple distinct control signals to enable finer-grained control over reasoning behaviors.
items.hard_negative: Inserting multiple identical <pause> tokens in a row.

items.name: layer_recurrent_execution
items.description: Introduces iterative computation within the model's architecture to progressively refine hidden states.
items.hard_negative: Making the Transformer literally 1000 layers deep with completely distinct parameters for each layer.
